cbor.encoding: RFC8949 core deterministic; exact fixed map; no tags, duplicates, unknown fields or trailing bytes

uuid: canonical lowercase UUID v4; RFC variant 10; binary network order
public_key_sha256: SHA256 of registered 65-byte uncompressed SEC1 P-256 public point, not hexadecimal text
claim_secret: 32 independent CSPRNG bytes per device; nonzero; private first-claim bearer proof; never device private key or BT passkey
packaging: concealed private claim QR; visible labels contain public identity only
authority: untrusted input; online registry and claim verification required
versioning: Any change to field semantics, lengths, encodings or accepted forms requires a new reviewed profile version; never silently relax v1.
